budget.basis: 1 night, 1 room, 2 adults. The cheapest double or twin shown on the page, total including taxes and fees as displayed, in GBP. Hotels.com (uk.hotels.com) for every property it sells; premierinn.com for Premier Inn and hub by Premier Inn, which do not sell through Hotels.com; the operator's own engine (mews) for a property Hotels.com lists but has no rooms for on any sample night.
budget.rule: A hotel is budget when its median sampled night is £150 or less (Rob, 14 Sep 2026). Needs 3+ priced nights.

notPriced.name: The Lime Tree Hotel
notPriced.reason: No one-night stay for 2 adults could be booked on any of the five sample nights, on either channel (14 Sep 2026). Hotels.com: 'can't accommodate 2 guests' on 11 and 17 Oct, 'no rooms available at this property' on 17 Feb, 12 Dec and 17 Apr (captures kept in budget-2026-09-14.json). The operator's own SynXis engine (bookings.limetreehotel.co.uk, titled 'Room Mate Lime Tree - Reservations'): 'check-in/check-out combination is not available' for 11 Oct, 17 Feb and 12 Dec; 'cannot accept departures' on the Sunday after 17 Oct and 17 Apr, i.e. no one-night Saturday stays. For scale only, not a sampled night: the room-matehotels.com calendar showed from-prices of £241-£375 for other October 2026 nights (1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 12 Oct).
